facts.fact: Mimi Mott 公开悼念妹妹 Pamela Mackie——她上月在意大利自然离世。
facts.anchor: paid tribute to her sister, Pamela Mackie, who died of natural causes in Italy last month

facts.fact: 姐妹俩距离完成「毕生之旅」——遍访欧洲最顶尖园林的壮游——只差几天。
facts.anchor: The sisters were just days from completing the trip of a lifetime, a grand tour of Europe’s finest gardens.

facts.fact: Mott 告诉 @AroundTown：Pamela 在两人造访威尼斯 Giardino Storico di Palazzo Soranzo Cappello（她一直梦想亲见的园林）之后，于睡梦中安详离世。
facts.anchor: passed peacefully in her sleep after our visit to Venice

facts.fact: Mackie 去年 12 月在 Mott 的 A Life in Objects 预展夜爆红，长期疏远的姐妹在彼处重逢。
facts.anchor: shot to viral fame last December at Mott

facts.fact: Mackie 与她的狗掀起 #SoPamelaMackie 梗图浪潮；她在 Lordats 活动的演讲推高远超估价的狂热在线竞价，拍卖为慈善筹得巨款。
facts.anchor: delivered the ultimate sibling-disrupter speech at the Lordats event, stoking feverish online bidding that far exceeded estimates. The auction raised huge sums for charity.

facts.fact: Mott 引 Pamela 的遗言「life is circular, not linear」并说她说得对。
facts.anchor: Pamela always said life is circular, not linear, and she was right.

facts.fact: Mott 回美国的新目标：为 Nancy Caswell Foundation 募款，多年之后重新开始设计。
facts.anchor: fundraising for the Nancy Caswell Foundation and, after many years, designing again

facts.fact: Mott 愿把余夏留给威尔特郡：与家人吃草莓、下河游泳，知道妹妹「总在前面几划」。
facts.anchor: I hope to spend in Wiltshire with family, eating strawberries and swimming in the river
